summary: Completed backend and frontend regression testing for authentication, rooms, profile editing, discovery, founder info, and responsive navigation.
action_items: Google OAuth remains a clearly marked PLACEHOLDER and requires OAuth credentials/configuration if real login is later requested.
critical_code_review_comments: ProfileView mutates the parent user object directly after save; consider lifting state update to Shell for reliable header/sidebar refresh in future changes.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST-prefixed profile values, room parent/reply/reaction records, and browser test records; no seeded records were intentionally modified beyond the admin profile test values.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth cookie/me/logout, room selection/post/reply/reaction, profile PUT, discovery search, founder info, and mobile overflow all passed. Image file upload was not exercised because no local fixture image was available; Google OAuth is intentionally mocked/PLACEHOLDER.
rca of the issue: Prior iteration's blank room-card report could not be reproduced: current implementation renders room selection controls and conversation flow successfully. Initial browser console 401s were expected unauthenticated /api/auth/me checks before login, not runtime failures.
